ingredients: Important information Directions 1. Place the spaghetti noodles across the bowl. 2. Carefully lay the Yeti on top of the noodles. 3. Take turns removing one noodle at a time, ensuring the Yeti does not fall into the bowl. 4. The last player to successfully remove a noodle without causing the Yeti to fall wins the game.
key_features: HILARIOUS FAMILY GAME NIGHT FAVORITE: Bring laughter to your next family game night with Yeti in My Spaghetti! This fast-paced kids board game keeps everyone on edge as players carefully remove noodles without letting the Yeti fall. Perfect for all ages and guaranteed giggles

EASY-TO-LEARN, QUICK TO PLAY: No complicated rules, set up in seconds and start playing right away! Ideal for preschoolers, kids, and adults alike. A great balance of suspense and fun for family gatherings, classrooms, or rainy-day entertainment

ENGAGES KIDS’ FOCUS & FINE MOTOR SKILLS: Encourage hand-eye coordination, patience, and concentration as children strategize which noodle to pull next. Great for early learning and developmental play while keeping it lighthearted and silly

PERFECT GIFT FOR KIDS AGES 4+: Looking for a unique gift idea? Yeti in My Spaghetti is a hit for birthdays, holidays, and stocking stuffers. Parents love it for its simplicity, and kids can’t get enough of the excitement
